This enset plot behind my house has fed my family for many years, and it needs only the cow manure I collect from my animals. I never get enough chemical fertilizer from the cooperative for all my land, so I save what little I receive for my annual crops like teff and maize. My wife and children help me weed and harvest here, so we do not need to hire anyone from outside.
